# Restorino SDK

> TypeScript client for the Restorino restaurant SaaS public API — storefront,
> online ordering, customer account, loyalty and live voice agent.

## Start here
- [One-shot agent build guide](./LOVABLE_PROMPT.md) — exhaustive, verified API reference, payload shapes, recipes and a definition-of-done checklist.
- [Compact copy-paste prompt](./prompt.txt) — same contract, condensed.
- [README](./README.md) — install, deployment, security guarantees.

## Ground truth
- Package: `@restorino/sdk` (v1.1.0, zero runtime dependencies)
- Types: `dist/index.d.ts`
- Single-file bundle: `dist-bundle/restorino-sdk.ts`
- All money values are `number`; all dates are ISO-8601 strings.

## Non-negotiable
- Authentication is **cookie-based** (`credentials: 'include'`). `login()` returns
  the customer profile, never a token. Check the session with `auth.getMe()`.
- Do **not** persist tokens in `localStorage` (the default `storageType` is memory).
- **Storefront scope only.** Calls outside `/api/public/**`,
  `/api/auth/customers/**`, `/api/customers/**`,
  `/api/notifications/customers/**` and public vitrine reads throw
  `OUT_OF_SCOPE_ENDPOINT` before leaving the browser. There is no API-key
  support: the only credential is the customer cookie.
- Order creation uses `deliveryMethod` (`delivery|takeout|dine-in`) and lowercase
  `paymentMethod`; each item requires `totalPrice`.
- Never submit `total`/`tax` — the server recomputes and rejects drift.

## Modules
`auth` · `vitrine` · `orders` · `tables` · `customer` · `loyalty` · `delivery` · `liveAgent`
